_meta.source: User-supplied host axis settings, 2026-10-09. One machine only; the platform is general purpose, so never use these as defaults.
_meta.units_as_reported: velocity mm/s, acceleration and deceleration mm/s^2, jerk mm/s^3; identical to controller $11x/60, $12x, $81x, $80x (see machine_example_settings.txt)
_meta.accelerationProfile: 0 = constant acceleration (trapezoidal velocity), 1 = sine velocity (out of scope), 2 = trapezoidal acceleration (S-curve velocity)
notes: Deceleration is deliberately asymmetric; the 10x lower X/Y value was an extreme test of the algorithm.
Values were entered from inch/min figures (x25.4/60); they are what the firmware actually uses.
Firmware has no per-axis profile type: with ENABLE_JERK_ACCELERATION every axis, including Z, is jerk-limited by $80x.
open_questions: accelerationJerk vs decelerationJerk: which phases use which (by sign of acceleration, or speeding up vs slowing down). Equal here; firmware has one jerk per axis.
_meta.context: Occasional slow final move: two collinear Z moves, the second too short to reach max acceleration or velocity. Regression input only; general correctness is the goal.
